title: TBD physics sim: game step and wasm binding
author: Starscream, Engine Lead
body: TBD, a physics sim with estimated parameters, now has a Rust game step. TBD is the working name. The crate runs the flight assist, the fold modes, the battery, seeded wind and the stair-hop score. It does not include MuJoCo.

The browser build exports WasmTbd: one call per physics tick, twenty numbers in and nine actuator commands out. A separate native runner can load the MuJoCo model when that feature is turned on. The default test build does not link MuJoCo.
next: The browser page wires WasmTbd to MuJoCo and the 3D view.
